import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb

# Set paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_CSV = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Separate target columns
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_columns = train_df[target_cols].values.astype(float)

# Get text and labels separately
train_texts = train_df["comment_text"].values
all_texts = np.concatenate([train_texts, test_df["comment_text"].values])

# Split training data into train/validation
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_texts,
    y_columns,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_columns.mean(axis=1),
)

# Initialize TF-IDF vectorizer with increased capacity
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, lowercase=True
)

# Fit on all texts for consistency in feature extraction
X_train_tfidf = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts).toarray()
X_val_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(X_val_text).toarray()
X_all_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(all_texts).toarray()
X_test_tfidf = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"]).toarray()

# Train individual XGBoost models for each toxicity type
models = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        scale_pos_weight=y_train[:, i] == 0 if i < len(y_train) else 1,
        eval_metric="auc",
        random_state=42,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_tfidf, y_train[:, i], verbose=False)
    models.append(model)
    print(f"Trained XGBoost model for {col}")

# Validate on held-out validation set (never seen by final model)
validation_aucs = []
for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    y_val_true = y_val[:, i]

    val_proba = models[i].predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_true, val_proba)
    validation_aucs.append(auc)
    print(f"{col} Validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

avg_validation_auc = np.mean(validation_aucs)
print(f"\n*** FINAL VALIDATION METRIC ***")
print(f"Average ROC AUC (column-wise): {avg_validation_auc:.6f}")

# Make final predictions on TEST data only
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Build submission DataFrame
submission_data = {
    "id": [],
    "toxic": [],
    "severe_toxic": [],
    "obscene": [],
    "threat": [],
    "insult": [],
    "identity_hate": [],
}

for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    pred_proba = models[i].predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)[:, 1]
    submission_data[col] = pred_proba.tolist()

submission_id = [str(x) for x in test_ids]
submission_data["id"] = submission_id

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_CSV, index=False)
